messages:
incident-bot: Pager: metering-heartbeat anomaly detected in prod-eu1. token-aggregator counts diverging vs canonical ledger. Severity: P2. Alert: overage flags firing for ~0.4% of customers. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-drift

eric_oncall: I'm on it, grabbing logs and checking recent deploys.

jen_sre: starting a read-only reconcile against canonical store, will also flip emitter to passive fallback for 30m. Command:
```bash
kubectl -n metering exec deploy/token-emitter -- emitter-cli --mode passive --duration 30m
``` 

raj_billing: Confirming there's a spike in overage flags in billing dashboard. See query run:
```sql
SELECT customer_id, count(1) as tok_count
FROM billing.events
WHERE ts > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 2 HOUR)
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY tok_count DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

maria_cs: Lina, can you prep a short customer note for impacted accounts (no billing changes yet) — we'll update after recon.

lina_support: Yep, drafting. Need ETA for mitigation?

eric_oncall: ETA ~20-30m for fallback flip and reconcile results. If reconcile shows <0.1% divergence we'll close.

sam_billing_lead: Do we need to mute auto-overage emails? Might cause churn.

raj_billing: Recommend mute for affected cohort only. Add a margin check: don't mute if there's confirmed usage increase from customer side.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026.03.20.02 to token-emitter succeeded :white_check_mark:

jen_sre: Early reconcile shows emitter offsets ~+1200 tokens/min in eu1 aggregator vs canonical for partition 42. Running a short backfill job now.

eric_oncall: Backfill kicked. Job id: bf-779999-01. Logs:
```text
[bf-779999-01] start reconcile partition=42
processed=0/4500
```

maria_cs: Notifying top 12 affected customers with "observed anomaly" draft (no charge language). Lina to send after my OK.

lina_support: ready to send.

jen_sre: Backfill progress 45%. If job completes and counts reconcile, we'll re-enable normal emitter mode and unmute emails.

eric_oncall: Backfill completed at +58m. Diff reduced to ~0.03%.

raj_billing: Verified overage flags cleared in dashboard. No actual billing spikes found in canonical totals.

sam_billing_lead: Good. Recommend postmortem to track root cause — likely aggregator double-count on high-latency path.

maria_cs: Sent customer note to impacted cohort at 2026-03-20 04:12 UTC. Template: short apology + explanation + contact.

jen_sre: Follow-up actions: 1) add tighter idempotency checks to emitter 2) add counter sanity alerts w/ rolling 1hr baseline 3) run replay test on staging. I'll own 1 & 3. Raj own 2.

eric_oncall: Closing pager. Thanks team :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Pager resolved. Duration 00:58:40. Summary: emitter double-count on high-latency path -> reconcile/backfill mitigated; customer notifications sent.
